ops.loadingHours: The reception desk for load-in and load-out differs by time of day. From 9:00 to 12:00 and from 13:00 to 17:20, complete the procedure at the east loading entrance: the person in overall charge of the load-in/out tells the desk the project name, venue name and company name, and receives entry passes for all staff. At all other times, including 12:00 to 13:00, first complete the procedure at the Disaster Prevention Center and then go to the east loading entrance. The loading entrance is covered, and goods can be carried directly to the venue by the freight elevator; available 24 hours (guidance for exhibitions). Vehicle height limits at the loading entrances are 3.7 m at the east loading entrance and 3.4 m at the materials loading entrance. The load-in/out elevator measures W3,000 x H2,500 x D6,000 mm with a load capacity of 4,500 kg.
ops.vehicleRules: Work vehicles such as trucks may not be left standing except during load-in and load-out work. Move the vehicle when the work is finished. The vehicle height limit at the B2 parking entrance is 2.1 m.
ops.parking: On B2, 374 spaces in total (self-propelled and mechanical; height limit 2.1 m). Open 24 hours; the fee is 550 yen (tax included) per 30 minutes. Banquet and wedding guests park free for 6 hours. Parking reservations are not accepted. Vehicle limits: length 6.0 m, width 2.5 m, height 2.1 m (self-propelled; mechanical: length 5.0 m, width 2.0 m, height 1.55 m, 1.7 t or less). For trucks, buses and other large vehicles that cannot enter the basement, a space on the 1st floor is offered for hotel guests at 8,000 yen per night, with advance reservation required (limited number of spaces).
ops.waitingRooms: There is a shared men's and women's changing room with tatami flooring on the 1F. The small banquet and meeting rooms on the 1F (Pensee, Mimosa, Cosmos, Camellia) are described as rooms that can be used for meetings, waiting rooms and so on. (Digital brochure)
ops.restaurants: Inside the hotel are The Grill on 30th, The Bar & Lounge, Teppanyaki Icho (鉄板焼 銀杏), Sushi Tamakagari (鮨 玉かがり) and Tempura Tamae (天ぷら 玉衣) (all on the 30F), Chinese Restaurant Toh-Lee (中国料理 桃李) and The Lobby Cafe (both on the 2F), GARDEN DINING (1F), and Italian Restaurant Incontro (イタリア料理 インコントロ) (Atrium Wing 2F), among others. The official website has a page on private rooms and exclusive use.
